title: fix: sync widget values to workflow metadata in graphToPrompt
key_points: When batch count > 1, every saved image embeds the first iteration's metadata (seed, prompt), making images 2-N non-reproducible.
The root cause is that `graphToPrompt` captures the workflow snapshot via `graph.serialize()` before the widget loop, so `serializeValue` transforms are never reflected in `extra_pnginfo`.
This PR syncs each widget's resolved value back into the serialized workflow node's `widgets_values` array after serialization, so the embedded metadata always matches the actual execution inputs.
limitations: The sync only touches widgets where `widget.serialize !== false`, matching the existing filter
Object values are deep-cloned to prevent reference sharing between batches
Subgraph inner nodes (colon-separated IDs) are not in the root workflow node list and are safely skipped
asserts: This pull request fixes an issue where images saved in a batch with count > 1 embed the metadata from the first iteration's execution, making later images non-reproducible by altering their embedded metadata.
scope: The scope of this assertion is limited to syncing each widget's resolved value back into the serialized workflow node's `widgets_values` array after serialization, so the embedded metadata matches the actual execution inputs.
